The test only actually exercises `data_samples()` and `test_Symmetry454Date_until_LocalDate`. All the other data providers and most imports are dead code. Let me write a focused, readable version.`period` is inherited from `Chronology`. Now I'll write the focused, readable version.Compiles cleanly (`COMPILE_OK`).

I improved understandability by removing the 13 unused data providers and ~40 unused imports (the original only ever exercised `data_samples`), adding Javadoc and an inline comment explaining *why* the period is expected to be zero (the Sym454 date and ISO date are the same day), and reformatting the sample table one pair per line with tidy historical-anchor comments. Runtime behaviour is unchanged: the same `sym454.until(iso)` calls are asserted against the same zero `period(0, 0, 0)`.
